name: flawless-spirit-of-mordred-levels-up-into-mordred
notes: Flawless Spirit of Mordred (cXEI5vo6iG): same setup as flawless-spirit-of-mordred-cannot-level-up-into- non-mordred, but the real level-up goes into Mordred, Burnished Avenger (memory cost 1), which the Spirit's restriction allows: the champion becomes Burnished Avenger with the Spirit in its lineage.

rulesClauses: Flawless Spirit of Mordred can level up into a "Mordred" champion.
